description: How a bet365 price or line moved: one row per change, each with the interval it held (observed_at to last_seen_at). Free keys read the last 24 hours; paid plans read every change since collection began. Needs an API key. For changes pushed as they happen (alerts, live line tracking), the same key connects to the WebSocket wss://stream.thebet365api.com/v1/stream; see https://thebet365api.com/docs#websocket.

event_id.description: An event id from list_bet365_events, such as an-295471 or espn-401879233.

user_request.description: The current user task in one sentence. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: get_bet365_line_history
